scope: Table 5 external stream entries /F, /FFilter, /FDecodeParms, plus the §7.4.1 external-filter rule and the adopted caller-supplied resolver boundary. Reconciles existing stream_dictionary_cells_current; not a general file-specification or filter-codec audit.

locations.source: §7.3.8.1 external stream data and stream/endstream rule
§7.4.1 external Filter and DecodeParms descriptions plus reader SHALL invoke filters

effective_rules: /F is optional from PDF1.2. Present F already requires ignoring embedded bytes. EC3 issue10 separately changes Length should to shall: Length still specifies their count, usually zero.
/FFilter names filters for data in the external file. /FDecodeParms gives their parameters under the same rules as ordinary DecodeParms.

§7.4.1 identifies FFilter/FDecodeParms as the external equivalents and says a PDF reader shall invoke the corresponding filters to restore original data. The text does not require a processor to obtain an external file from disk/network.

If /F is not present, the F-prefixed entries do not describe the embedded data; ordinary /Filter and /DecodeParms govern the embedded stream. This matches ADR 1199's adopted conversion interpretation.
source.errata: Parent matched issue10 linked strike x303.519–332.532/y181.409–191.369 to bbox word should at x303.51882/y648.838 on841.92-high physical47. It changes the Length requirement, not the already mandatory ignore-bytes sentence. FFilter/FDecodeParms semantics unchanged.

viewer_reader: crates/pdf-syntax/src/document/images.rs::Document::is_external tests presence of F directly; it does not resolve a FileSpec or open a path.
crates/pdf-syntax/src/document/decoding.rs::decoded_chain returns StreamRefusal::External before applying the ordinary Filter chain.
crates/pdf-syntax/src/document/sources.rs::stream_source refuses F streams; image_stream also refuses. These routes do not access a filesystem or network.
The sandbox worker is deliberately isolated from filesystem and network; no stream external-file resolver/broker is part of the viewer reader contract.
caller_supplied_conversion: crates/pdf-transform/src/archive/mod.rs::ArchivePlan has external_data: BTreeMap<ObjectId, Arc<[u8]>> supplied by the caller.

crates/pdf-transform/src/bin/quorra-transform.rs::resolve_the_external_data honors explicit --resolve-external-data for a plain file name beside the source, refuses URLs and out-of-directory paths, and inserts supplied bytes into the plan.

crates/pdf-transform/src/archive/external.rs::embedded_stream replaces embedded bytes with caller-supplied bytes, maps FFilter to Filter and FDecodeParms to DecodeParms, recalculates Length, and removes external keys.
This conversion route is distinct from normal document viewing and does not grant the PDF reader host access.

assertions.evidence: Exact-xref public API pair. Same embedded ASCIIHex bytes decode to literal content without F; with F and FFilter, stream_source and decoded_stream_data refuse and nested_content_source reports External. This exercises the pre-existing Table5 ignore-bytes rule while avoiding any claim that embedded bytes are external data.
assertions.limit: Does not fetch external bytes or decode FFilter/FDecodeParms.

assertions.evidence: Caller supplies encoded bytes through ArchivePlan; output has ordinary Filter and no F-prefixed keys. Existing parameter is Predictor 1 (default), and assertion checks key text/conformance but not decoded output or meaningful parameter effect.
assertions.limit: It does not discriminate a lost/ignored nondefault FDecodeParms value.

assertions.evidence: Covers transformation of orphan FFilter when no F exists, preserving stream bytes and output conformance. This concerns the archive rewrite, not viewer decoder behavior.
assertions.limit: Does not test a public reader with orphan F-prefixed keys; no new malformed-input obligation inferred.

assertions.evidence: Exercises the explicit local resolver rule, and refusal of parent traversal / mixed resolved-unresolved streams.
assertions.limit: The test does not claim URL/network access; this scope is intentionally refused.
